version_series_meaning: This package ships a model graph, and model_card_version names the trained model. It is a different series from package_version, which moves in lockstep across every mailwoman workspace on every release. `mwops release verify-metadata` keys the score ledger and release documentation off this number.

entries.text: HM Land Registry — Price Paid Data (OGL v3.0): the `synth-gb-v1` training extract (800,000 rows) NEW in 6.7.0. Crown copyright, attribution required. The GB placetype-pair index is built from the same source and ships in `neural-weights-en-gb`, whose own card carries its attribution.
LINZ-derived OpenAddresses NZ (CC-BY 4.0): the `synth-nz-v2` training extract (800,000 rows) NEW in 6.7.0.
OpenAddresses ES tuples (CC-BY per OA source): the `synth-es-pedania-v1` training extract (800,000 rows, below-municipio pedanía place names) NEW in 6.7.0.

BAN — Base Adresse Nationale (DINUM / IGN, Licence Ouverte 2.0): the `synth-fr-lieudit-v1` training extract (`nom_ld` lieu-dit field) NEW in 6.7.0, additional to the existing `synth-fr-fragment` extract (144,865 rows, 6.4.0).
Overture Maps Foundation — Addresses theme (CDLA-Permissive-2.0): the `overture-latam` CA/MX training extract (456,230 rows, 6.6.0). Attribution-only, not share-alike.
OpenAddresses CZ — ČÚZK RÚIAN (CC-BY 4.0): tokenizer-splice training text + the oa-cz coord eval sets
OpenAddresses PL — GUGiK / PRG (public, BDOT-derived): tokenizer-splice training text + the oa-pl coord eval sets
OpenAddresses SK — MINV/ZBGIS (CC-0/CC-BY per OA source): oa-sk coord eval set (free-rider validation)
OpenAddresses SI — GURS (CC-BY per OA source): oa-si coord eval set (free-rider validation)
See THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md for the standing OpenAddresses / GeoNames / WOF attribution.

corpus_version: v0.13.0-latam (v385's own feed, VERBATIM data section incl. punct_drop 0.3 + all source weights except synth-po-box-cedex 1.5→3.0 — the fine-tune replay boost) — the deploc additions (synth-gb 10.0 / nz / es-pedania / fr-lieudit) are PROBE PASSENGERS removed after the v3.22 feed attribution (GB street-boundary transfer + CA po-box dilution).
unresolved: No digest is recorded for 8 of 12 declared artifacts: calibration.json, calibration-per-locale.json, postcode-us.bin, pair-index-us.bin, fst-en-us.bin, fst-street-morphology.bin, anchor-lexicon-v1.json, country-surface-lexicon-v1.json. An unrecorded digest is not a verified one.
One attribution entry names no license: OpenAddresses PL — GUGiK / PRG (public, BDOT-derived): tokenizer-splice training text + the oa-pl coord eval sets
One attribution entry names no license: See THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md for the standing OpenAddresses / GeoNames / WOF attribution.

4 of 10 attribution entries describe evaluation or tokenizer text rather than training rows, so they attribute data this package's model did not learn from: OpenAddresses CZ — ČÚZK RÚIAN (CC-BY 4.0); OpenAddresses PL — GUGiK / PRG (public, BDOT-derived); OpenAddresses SK — MINV/ZBGIS (CC-0/CC-BY per OA source); OpenAddresses SI — GURS (CC-BY per OA source).
1 of 10 attribution entries do not say how the source was used, so whether it trained this model is unrecorded.

Which records trained the model this package ships or inherits is unresolved. `buildCorpus` writes a frozen `TRAINING_SOURCES.json` naming every source that contributed and under which terms, and no released model was built from a corpus carrying one. The corpus named above is the recipe's corpus rather than a record of what reached the model.
